title: The Fox and the Raven
summary: A raven holding a piece of meat was flattered by a fox about his singing. When the vain bird opened his mouth to caw, the meat dropped, and the fox devoured it with laughter....
full_text: A raven holding a piece of meat was flattered by a fox about his singing. When the vain bird opened his mouth to caw, the meat dropped, and the fox devoured it with laughter.
moral: Flattery is food for fools; guard your prize from smooth praise.
